series: plan-D revival on the portable E4 TQue base after judge environment change
single_hypothesis: Reading each token's m contiguous GM streams with ONE 2D-block DMA into a TQue slot (grouped backward, rowBlock=1 keeps replica slices contiguous and 16-aligned) cuts backward per-token command count from m+1 to 2 on mid shapes; built ONLY from constructs proven passing on the current judge (TQue cadence + 2D DataCopyParams block form; no raw V-pipe events, no count-form copies).
e6_postmortem_fix: E6's TLE candidates (count-form large DataCopy, raw MTE2_V set/wait) are both eliminated: grouped read uses the 2D block form {1, m*D/16, 0, 0} and the queue cadence is plain TQue Alloc/EnQue/DeQue/Free identical to E4's passing backward.
